text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and E at a gain felt rewarding, but I should not sell winners just to lock in gains; decisions should depend on each stock’s current outlook and portfolio role.","My account value fell despite mostly doing nothing, so avoiding trades is not automatically prudent. I should review my holdings deliberately without treating short-term price moves as forecasts.","I should not let average cost or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate whether I hold or sell; assess each position on its merits while keeping diversification and risk in view."]}
